probe_purpose: Source reachability probe to size the next research run. Establishes what is fetchable and how rich it is. No content research performed.
tooling: WebSearch + WebFetch (WebFetch converts to markdown and does NOT execute JavaScript; a JS-gated page therefore returns an empty shell)

results.url: WebSearch query: "Zoho ERP API documentation erp/v3"
results.purpose: Establish whether a public Zoho ERP /erp/v3 API doc site exists at all
results.observation: Returned six results, five on www.zoho.com/erp/api/v3/: introduction/, oauth/, integration/, departments/, projects/. Confirms a public, indexed /erp/v3 documentation tree exists. Search snippet named the API root as https://www.zohoapis.in/erp/v3.

results.purpose: Zoho ERP API doc root: is it server-rendered, does it expose an endpoint index?
results.observation: Server-rendered prose returned verbatim: "The Zoho ERP API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client. Zoho ERP API is built using REST principles, which ensures predictable URIs and makes writing applications easy." API root given as https://www.zohoapis.in/erp/v3. Full left-hand nav enumerated 84 modules including Contacts, Items, Locations, Inventory Adjustments, Transfer Orders, Purchase Receives, Purchase Order, Bills, Recurring Bills, Vendor Credits, Vendor Payments, Expenses, Sales Order, Bill of Materials, Manufacturing Orders, Job Cards, Projects, Tasks, Time Entries, Chart Of Accounts, Journals, Bank Accounts, Fixed Assets, Transaction Locking, Reporting Tags, Custom Modules, ZOHO CRM Integration. NOTE: the nav contains NO 'Purchase Requests' entry and NO 'Request for Quotes' entry.

results.purpose: Zoho ERP OAuth: scope grammar, token lifetimes, data-centre domains
results.observation: Verbatim: "Scope determines which protected resource of an end-user a client has requested access to." Scope grammar documented as service_name.scope_name.operation_type with operation types CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE, ALL. Access token lifetime 1 hour (3600s); refresh token unlimited until revoked, max 20 per user. Only the IN data centre is shown on this page (https://accounts.zoho.in, https://www.zohoapis.in). Scope names listed cover contacts, settings, manufacturing, estimates, invoices, customer payments, credit notes, projects, expenses, sales orders, purchase orders, bills, debit notes, vendor payments, banking, accounting.

results.purpose: Does an individual Zoho ERP endpoint page exist and render with methods/paths/fields?
results.observation: Verbatim: "A purchase order is an official document that a buyer issues to a seller, indicating relevant information about what they want to buy, the quantity, the price agreed for that particular product or service." 27 method+path rows returned, including POST /purchaseorders, GET /purchaseorders/{purchaseorder_id}, POST /purchaseorders/{purchaseorder_id}/submit, /approve, /reject, /status/open, /status/billed, /status/cancelled. Full request-body field list returned (purchaseorder_number, vendor_id, line_items, location_id, project_id, hsn_or_sac, etc.). Scope names were not rendered inline on this page even though the search snippet quoted ERP.purchaseorders.CREATE.

results.purpose: Probe #5 - purchasereceives endpoint page (correct slug found on second attempt)
results.observation: Page exists and renders. Verbatim fragment: "a new purchase receive can be created", requiring URL parameter purchaseorder_id. Methods: POST /purchasereceives, PUT|GET|DELETE /purchasereceives/{purchasereceive_id}. Page states OAuth scopes are required per operation (CREATE/UPDATE/READ/DELETE).

results.purpose: Slug-guess variant for purchase receives
results.observation: HTTP 404 Not Found. Slug guessing is unreliable on this doc site: the nav label 'Purchase Receives' maps to /purchasereceives/ (no hyphen) while the nav label 'Purchase Order' maps to /purchase-order/ (hyphen). Both conventions coexist.

results.purpose: Second slug-guess variant for purchase receives
results.observation: HTTP 404 Not Found.

results.purpose: Probe #5 - bills endpoint page
results.observation: Renders. Described as recording vendors' invoices and tracking them until payment. 24 method+path rows returned including POST /bills, POST /bills/{bill_id}/submit, POST /bills/{bill_id}/approve, POST /bills/{bill_id}/status/void, GET /bills/editpage/frompurchaseorders (PO-to-bill conversion). No OAuth scope names rendered inline on this page.

results.purpose: Probe #5 - fixedassets endpoint page
results.observation: Renders with scopes. 18 method+path rows: POST/GET /fixedassets, PUT|GET|DELETE /fixedassets/{fixed_asset_id}, GET /fixedassets/{fixed_asset_id}/history and /forecast, POST .../writeoff, .../sell, .../status/active|cancel|draft, plus /fixedassettypes CRUD. OAuth scopes rendered inline: ERP.fixedasset.CREATE, ERP.fixedasset.READ, ERP.fixedasset.UPDATE.

results.purpose: Probe #5 - journals endpoint page
results.observation: Renders. Richest page probed: 31 method+path rows including POST /journals, POST /journals/{journal_id}/status/publish, /reverse, /submit, /approve, /reject, credits-application endpoints (/journals/{journal_id}/credits/{journal_line_id}/invoices|bills), bulk operations (/journals/submit, /journals/approve, /journals/bulkdelete), full /recurringjournals CRUD, and GET /transactions/{transaction_id}/journals. OAuth scope rendered: ERP.accountants.CREATE.

results.purpose: Assess Zoho ERP Projects/Tasks as the native hierarchy carrier for a WBS mapping
results.observation: Renders. 25 method+path rows including POST /projects, POST /projects/{project_id}/clone, /users, /users/invite, /comments, /invoices, and nested tasks (POST|GET /projects/{project_id}/tasks, PUT|GET|DELETE /projects/{project_id}/tasks/{task_id}). Scopes ERP.projects.CREATE and ERP.projects.UPDATE rendered. Hierarchy is exactly TWO levels (project -> task); no self-referencing parent WBS-element field was surfaced. This is a material constraint for any n-level WBS mapping and must be re-verified in depth in the main run.

results.purpose: Assess the fallback path (custom module) in case native objects are missing
results.observation: Renders. Verbatim: "Create a custom module to record other data when predefined modules are insufficient". Endpoints POST|GET /settings/modules, PUT|GET|DELETE /settings/modules/{module_api_name}, and generic record CRUD at /{module_name} and /{module_name}/{module_id}. Scopes ERP.settings.CREATE / READ / UPDATE / DELETE. This is the documented, citable fallback carrier for any object with no native endpoint.

results.purpose: Probe #4 - confirm Purchase Request exists as a PRODUCT feature even if not as an API

results.purpose: Probe #3 - generic Zoho OAuth protocol doc
results.observation: Renders but is introductory only. Verbatim: "OAuth 2.0 is an industry standard protocol which allows you to grant a third-party website or an application delegated access to the protected resources of Zoho." Access token 1 hour; refresh token validity not quantified. NO data-centre domain list and NO scope grammar on this page - both are deferred to other pages.

results.purpose: Probe #3 - authoritative data-centre domain list (ERP OAuth page only showed IN)
results.observation: Renders a full DC table: US accounts.zoho.com / www.zohoapis.com; EU accounts.zoho.eu / www.zohoapis.eu; AU accounts.zoho.com.au / www.zohoapis.com.au; IN accounts.zoho.in / www.zohoapis.in; CN accounts.zoho.com.cn / www.zohoapis.com.cn; JP accounts.zoho.jp / www.zohoapis.jp; CA accounts.zohocloud.ca / www.zohoapis.ca. CAVEAT: this is the CRM doc, not the ERP doc; only the EU and CN API domains were literally printed on the page and the rest follow the stated pattern. Cite as CRM-sourced, and flag SA/CN applicability separately.

results.observation: USABLE PROSE RETURNED from a static Jekyll site. Verbatim: "Most classical SAP GUI business transactions aren't considered to be very user friendly. In contrast to that, users are getting more and more accustomed to intuitive and simple user interfaces in their daily life." Covers seven floorplans including List Report and Object Page plus the five design principles. CAVEAT: DSAG is a user group, NOT SAP. Cite only as a secondary/corroborating source, never as the normative guideline.

verdict.recommended_lane_adjustment: Zoho ERP docs came back RICH, not thin - so do NOT execute the fallback-architecture re-allocation. Every /erp/v3 page probed rendered server-side with complete method+path tables, request-body field names, and (on most pages) inline OAuth scope names; the introduction page yields a full 84-module index that can seed the endpoint inventory directly. Concrete sizing: (1) R11/R12/R13 keep their full endpoint-verification budget and should each cite a real /erp/v3/<module>/ page per row; expect roughly 85-90 percent of endpoint rows to land VERIFIED. (2) Reserve the UNVERIFIED budget - expect 10-15 percent of rows - for exactly three known gaps, not spread thinly: (a) PURCHASE REQUEST, which is a confirmed clean negative - it exists as a product feature in the help docs but has NO API page under any slug tried and does not appear in the 84-module nav, so every PR row must be marked UNVERIFIED and routed to the documented Custom Modules fallback (/settings/modules + /{module_name}), which IS citable; Request for Quotes is absent from the nav too and should be assumed the same until checked; (b) OAuth scope names, which render inline on some pages (fixedassets, journals, projects, custom modules) but NOT on others (purchaseorders, bills) - budget a dedicated scope-reconciliation pass against /erp/v3/oauth/ rather than assuming the service_name.scope_name.operation_type pattern holds, since the observed strings are inconsistent (ERP.fixedasset singular vs ERP.purchaseorders plural vs ERP.accountants); (c) the ERP Projects hierarchy, which surfaced only TWO levels (project -> task) with no self-referencing parent field - an n-level WBS will need an explicit design decision and that analysis deserves the effort freed up by not needing a full fallback architecture. (3) Add a small fixed cost for slug discovery: the doc site mixes hyphenated and unhyphenated slugs (/purchase-order/ vs /purchasereceives/), so drive URLs from the introduction-page nav or from search, never from guessing - three of the probe 404s here were pure slug guesses. (4) No OpenAPI/Postman artifact exists for ERP (no /erp/api/v3/apicollection/, no zoho/erp-oas repo, and zoho/crm-oas is CRM-only), so budget for MANUAL transcription of endpoint tables from HTML; there is no bulk-import shortcut. (5) Shift effort AWAY from SAP fetching, which is where the real loss is: help.sap.com/docs/ is entirely JS-gated (0 of 3 modern pages returned prose) and www.sap.com/design-system/ returns 403 on all 4 URLs tried across two path shapes, with every legacy experience.sap.com URL now a dead 301. Re-point the SAP lane at the two routes that actually work - legacy static help.sap.com/doc/saphelp_*/.../content.htm pages (2 of 3 returned real prose) and learning.sap.com/courses/... lesson pages (2 of 2 returned real prose, though full course bodies are partly auth-gated) - and treat DSAG's 1dsag.github.io mirror as secondary corroboration only. Assume roughly half the SAP citations originally planned against help.sap.com/docs and experience.sap.com will need URL substitution, and budget that rewrite time explicitly.

notes: 38 probes recorded: 33 direct WebFetch attempts and 5 WebSearch queries. Nothing here is inferred - every OK row carries a verbatim snippet returned by the fetch, and every 404/403 row is a real HTTP status. Key asymmetry: the Zoho risk that motivated this probe did not materialise (docs are rich and server-rendered), while the SAP sources that were assumed safe are the ones that failed. Two source migrations discovered that will silently break pre-written URLs: experience.sap.com -> www.sap.com/design-system (then 403), and learning.sap.com/learning-journeys/ -> learning.sap.com/courses/ (the old form 404s while search engines still return it). One caveat carried forward: the data-centre domain table is sourced from the Zoho CRM v8 multi-dc page, not from ERP documentation, and the ERP OAuth page itself shows only the IN data centre - do not present the seven-DC table as ERP-documented. Not probed and still open: Request for Quotes API existence, whether Zoho ERP has SA/CN data-centre parity, and whether ui5.sap.com/sdk exposes any non-hash server-rendered route.
